city.title: City
city.description: City of the pincode. Populated only when Pincode Status is SERVICEABLE.

district.title: District
district.description: District of the pincode. Populated only when Pincode Status is SERVICEABLE.

pincodeStatus.title: Pincode Status
pincodeStatus.description: Result of the pincode check. SERVICEABLE = valid 6-digit pincode where service is available. INVALID_FORMAT = not exactly 6 digits or contains non-numeric characters. NOT_SERVICEABLE = valid format but service is not available. ERROR = the check could not be completed.

state.title: State
state.description: State of the pincode. Populated only when Pincode Status is SERVICEABLE.
